source: Orion cartel territories (G15.44) — cartel Home Territory + Operating Zone, provided by user 2026-08-01. Cluster corrected to G15.442 on 2026-10-21.
note: A cartel has UNLIMITED access to option weapons produced in a Home empire; up to 20% of the force's option mounts may draw from Operating-Zone empires; up to 10% from any other (Outside) empire (G15.441). That is enforced as 'home unlimited, operating <= 20%, outside <= 10%', which is the same statement because the three shares sum to 100 — and it is why G15.442's exception needs no special case, only a different shape: see Cluster. Empire names are canonical: Federation, Klingon, Kzinti, Lyran, LDR, Hydran, Romulan, Gorn, ISC, WYN. NOTE: 'Dragon' is listed with Operating Zone = Federation (same as its Home) — flagged for confirmation; as written it simply has no operating zone beyond its home.

cartels.name: Cluster
cartels.notes: G15.442, the protected shipyard: the Cluster treats Kzinti, Lyran and Klingon space as HOME territory (90% of weapons) and takes the other 10% from anywhere. So those three are home empires rather than an operating zone, and the zone is empty — which, with outside capped at 10%, yields 90/10 out of the ordinary arithmetic. 'The WYNs are under the same restrictions as the Cluster Cartel.'
